Provide the department name, phone number, and the total number of students subscribed to the mailing list from that department. If multiple departments have the same highest count, list each one separately.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH list_key AS (
    SELECT moira_list_key
    FROM moira_list
    WHERE LOWER(moira_list_name) = 'ocean-apple'
), list_members AS (
    SELECT d.moira_list_member,
           d.moira_list_member_mit_id
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    JOIN list_key k ON d.moira_list_key = k.moira_list_key
), member_tokens AS (
    SELECT
      LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_member)) AS raw_member,
      CASE
        WHEN POSITION('@' IN TRIM(moira_list_member)) > 0 THEN LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_member))
        ELSE LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_member)) || '@mit.edu'
      END AS candidate_email,
      CASE
        WHEN POSITION('@' IN TRIM(moira_list_member)) > 0 THEN LOWER(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(moira_list_member),'@',1))
        ELSE LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_member))
      END AS candidate_kerb
    FROM list_members
), students_norm AS (
    SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email_address)) AS email_norm,
           LOWER(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(email_address),'@',1)) AS kerb_norm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(dePARTMENT_NAME),''), TRIM(DEPARTMENT)) AS dept_name_pref,
           TRIM(DEPARTMENT) AS dept_code_raw
    FROM mit_student_directory
    WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(email_address) <> ''
), member_students AS (
    SELECT m.raw_member,
           s.dept_name_pref,
           s.dept_code_raw
    FROM member_tokens m
    JOIN students_norm s
      ON s.email_norm = m.candidate_email OR s.kerb_norm = m.candidate_kerb
), dept_dim AS (
    SELECT LOWER(TRIM(department_code)) AS dept_code_dim,
           LOWER(TRIM(department_name)) AS dept_name_dim
    FROM sis_department
), admin_dept AS (
    SELECT LOWER(TRIM(sis_admin_department_code)) AS admin_code,
           LOWER(TRIM(sis_admin_department_name)) AS admin_name,
           TRIM(COALESCE(department_phone_area_code,'')) AS area,
           TRIM(CAST(COALESCE(department_phone_number,'') AS VARCHAR)) AS phone
    FROM sis_admin_department
), member_with_dim AS (
    SELECT ms.dept_name_pref,
           ms.dept_code_raw,
           COALESCE(d.dept_name_dim, LOWER(TRIM(ms.dept_name_pref))) AS dept_name_join,
           d.dept_code_dim
    FROM member_students ms
    LEFT JOIN dept_dim d
      ON LOWER(TRIM(ms.dept_code_raw)) = d.dept_code_dim OR LOWER(TRIM(ms.dept_name_pref)) = d.dept_name_dim
), member_counts AS (
    SELECT dept_name_join AS dept_name_lc,
           COUNT(*) AS student_count
    FROM member_with_dim
    WHERE dept_name_join IS NOT NULL AND dept_name_join <> ''
    GROUP BY 1
), max_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(student_count) AS max_count FROM member_counts
), dept_phone AS (
    SELECT mc.dept_name_lc,
           mc.student_count,
           ad.area,
           ad.phone
    FROM member_counts mc
    LEFT JOIN admin_dept ad
      ON mc.dept_name_lc = ad.admin_name
), ranked AS (
    SELECT dept_name_lc,
           student_count,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(area,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(phone,'') <> '' THEN '(' || area || ') ' || phone ELSE NULL END AS dept_phone
    FROM dept_phone
)
SELECT INITCAP(dept_name_lc) AS department_name,
       dept_phone AS department_phone,
       student_count AS total_students
FROM ranked r
JOIN max_ctE m ON r.student_count = m.max_count
ORDER BY department_name;
